about.title: A design bureau focused on interactive exhibits and installations
about.subtitle: Design and Interior Consultation Bureau designs interactive exhibits and physical installations — from museum touchscreens to kinetic sculpture and light art — for cultural institutions, festivals and public spaces.
about.storyBody: We started by consulting on exhibit interiors for regional museums and found ourselves designing more and more of the interactive touchscreens inside them. Today that spans both screens and physical space: interactive exhibit and installation design for institutions and festivals that want their story explored, not just viewed.
about.valueDurabilityBody: Every interface is designed for unsupervised, all-day, all-ages use — not a controlled demo environment.
about.valueCuratorialBody: Content tools are built so museum staff can update exhibits themselves, without calling us first.
about.valueLongevityBody: We favour maintainable hardware and software choices over whatever looks impressive on opening day.
